title: Pooja v. State (Domestic Violence)
text: The petitioner-wife, Pooja, filed this revision challenging dismissal of her application under the Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act. The Magistrate dismissed her application for protection orders and residence orders. The High Court examines the affidavit of the complainant and other evidence. The complainant suffered domestic violence within the shared household. The Domestic Violence Act is benevolent legislation for protection of women. The High Court sets aside the Magistrate's order and grants a protection order restraining the respondent-husband from committing acts of domestic violence. A residence order permitting the complainant to reside in the shared household is also issued. Monetary relief of Rs 15,000 per month for maintenance is awarded under the Domestic Violence Act. The complainant is entitled to all reliefs as prayed.
